summary: Russia launched mass drone and ballistic missile strikes across Ukraine overnight and into 24 September, hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Vinnytsia. Ukraine agreed to a full immediate unconditional ceasefire; Russia refused. Russia lost nearly 249,000 troops in eight months, per Zelenskyy.
key_points: Russia fired 3 ballistic missiles into Kyiv and launched 8 cruise missiles Banderol plus 2 KABs at Odesa overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75623, @mon1tor_ua/75620)

Overnight drone attacks hit a gas station in Holosiiv, warehouses, transport infrastructure in Darnytsia (1 injured), and the Amstor shopping center in Zaporizhzhia (2 wounded). (Source: @UkraineNow/84249)
Russian Mi-8 violated Polish airspace 300m deep near Braniewo for 42 seconds, flying from Kaliningrad; Polish fighters scrambled. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23858)
Ukraine agreed to full immediate unconditional ceasefire; Kremlin spokesman Peskov stated no preconditions for negotiations exist. (Source: @UkraineNow/84264, @UkraineNow/84260)
Russia liberated Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in NE Kharkiv region, per Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33454)

Multiple Geran-5 missiles struck Zhytomyr, Zviahel, and Rivne (Sarny district); Shahed drones targeted Kharkiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad/Mykolaiv border. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75600, @mon1tor_ua/75599, @mon1tor_ua/75595)

Syrsky reported serious supply shortages for Ukrainian forces, especially ground robotic systems; Zelenskyy demanded US winter package and Patriot missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33467, @ukr_leaks_eng/33457)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched mass drone and ballistic missile strikes across Ukraine overnight and into 24 September, hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, and Vinnytsia. Ukraine agreed to a full immediate unconditional ceasefire; Russia refused. Russia lost nearly 249,000 troops in eight months, per Zelenskyy.

points: Kyiv struck by multiple ballistic missiles and drones overnight: 3 ballistic missiles (mon1tor_ua/75623), 1 ballistic missile (mon1tor_ua/75622), launches from Bryansk (mon1tor_ua/75621, mon1tor_ua/75617). Fires at gas station in Holosiiv, warehouses, transport hub in Darnytsia with 1 injured, debris between residential buildings (UkraineNow/84249). Explosion near Kyiv railway station reported (ukr_leaks_eng/33455). Data center at Parkovy CEC attacked twice, confirmed by FM Kuleba; internet outages reported (UkraineNow/84267).

Supply shortages reported by former C-in-C Syrsky, especially ground robotic systems; referred inquiry to former Defense Minister Fedorov (ukr_leaks_eng/33467). Zelenskyy outlined conditions for ending war before winter: US political will, technology, winter package, Patriot missiles (ukr_leaks_eng/33457). Ukraine agreed to full immediate unconditional ceasefire (UkraineNow/84264).
Russia lost nearly 249,000 troops in Ukraine over eight months, exceeding population of 21 countries, per Zelenskyy (UkraineNow/84269, UkraineNow/84268).
Drones from Kyiv region struck northern Zhytomyr: Boiarka, Rokytne, Ivankiv/Dimer, Hnidyne, Barishivka, reservoir area (eRadarrua/116317; kpszsu/79796).
Israeli woman urged Ukrainian women to stop hiding abroad, take up arms to defend the country (ukr_leaks_eng/33459).

Kremlin spokesman Peskov stated no preconditions exist for peace negotiations; Zelenskyy could come to Moscow to negotiate, but knows what decisions are needed (UkraineNow/84260). US Secretary Rubio said no agreement on ending war yet; conflict will likely end via negotiation, not military victory (UkraineNow/84251).

Russian Mi-8 violated Polish airspace 300m near Braniewo, Warmian-Masurian, for 42 seconds, flying from Kaliningrad; Polish fighters scrambled, ground forces on alert. Russian troops conducting exercises in border area at time (DeepStateUA/23858).
Russia liberated Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in NE Kharkiv region, per Russian MoD (ukr_leaks_eng/33454).
Russian cruise missiles Banderol and KABs launched at Odesa; 8 Banderol + 2 KABs (mon1tor_ua/75620).
Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv to Kyiv/Vyshhorod area; from Zhytomyr to Zviahel; from Bryansk toward Kyiv (mon1tor_ua/75600, mon1tor_ua/75599, mon1tor_ua/75596, mon1tor_ua/75621).
Drone groups from southeast targeted Kharkiv region (kpszsu/79798). Multiple drone groups passed Novaya Vodolaga toward Poltava region (kpszsu/79821).
Reactive drone at Kirovohrad/Mykolaiv border, northwest course (kpszsu/79804).
Semenivka, Poltava region struck by drone from southeast (kpszsu/79811).
Russia liberated Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in NE Kharkiv (ukr_leaks_eng/33454).
Shahed drone at Maiaky, Odesa region (mon1tor_ua/75596).
Ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region toward Kyiv (mon1tor_ua/75621, mon1tor_ua/75617). 3 ballistic missiles hit Kyiv (mon1tor_ua/75623). 1 ballistic missile on Kyiv (mon1tor_ua/75622).
Geran-5 missile from north to Zhytomyr (mon1tor_ua/75600). Geran-5 to Zviahel, Zhytomyr (mon1tor_ua/75599).
Kyiv region hit: Boiarka, Rokytne, Ivankiv/Dimer, Hnidyne, Barashivka, reservoir (eRadarrua/116317). Drones from Kyiv region to northern Zhytomyr (kpszsu/79796).
Reactive Shahed from Zhytomyr to Rivne, Sarny district (mon1tor_ua/75595).
Odesa struck by 8 cruise missiles Banderol and 2 KABs (mon1tor_ua/75620). Shahed at Maiaky, Odesa region (mon1tor_ua/75596).
Amstor shopping center in Zaporizhzhia attacked twice in one day; fire, 2 wounded (UkraineNow/84249).
Reactive Shahed to Rivne from Zhytomyr direction (mon1tor_ua/75629, mon1tor_ua/75595).
Russian Mi-8 violated Polish airspace 300m near Braniewo for 42 seconds from Kaliningrad; Polish fighters scrambled, ground forces on alert (DeepStateUA/23858).
8 cruise missiles Banderol + 2 KABs at Odesa (mon1tor_ua/75620).
Multiple ballistic missiles from Bryansk to Kyiv: 3+1 confirmed (mon1tor_ua/75623, mon1tor_ua/75622, mon1tor_ua/75621).
4 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv/Vyshhorod; 1 reactive Shahed at Kirovohrad/Mykolaiv border; 1 Shahed at Maiaky Odesa (mon1tor_ua/75596).
Reactive Shahed from Zhytomyr to Rivne Sarny district (mon1tor_ua/75595). Geran-5 to Zviahel (mon1tor_ua/75599).
Drone threat yellow level over Kyiv at 22:58, red missile threat earlier (eRadarrua/116219, eRadarrua/116238).

key_developments: Russia launched mass ballistic missile and drone strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions overnight into 24 September, hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Zhytomyr, and Rivne with significant infrastructure damage and casualties. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75623, @UkraineNow/84249)
Ukraine agreed to full immediate unconditional ceasefire; Russia refused, with Peskov stating no preconditions for talks exist. (Source: @UkraineNow/84264, @UkraineNow/84260)
Russian Mi-8 violated Polish airspace 300m near Braniewo for 42 seconds from Kaliningrad; Polish fighters scrambled amid border troop exercises. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23858)
Russia liberated Krasny Yar and Potikhanovo in NE Kharkiv region per Russian MoD; multiple drone groups advance toward Poltava from Kharkiv direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33454, @kpszsu/79821)

Syrsky reported critical supply shortages for Ukrainian forces, especially ground robotic systems; Zelenskyy demanded US winter package and Patriot missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33467, @ukr_leaks_eng/33457)
Russia lost nearly 249,000 troops in Ukraine over eight months, Zelenskyy stated, exceeding population of 21 countries. (Source: @UkraineNow/84269)
Data center at Parkovy CEC in Kyiv attacked twice; Kuleba confirmed strikes on data centers; widespread internet outages reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/84267)
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is conducting sustained multi-axis aerial operations combining ballistic missiles, Geran-5, Shahed, cruise missiles Banderol, and KABs across Kyiv, Odesa, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv, and Poltava axes. The refusal to accept a ceasefire alongside mass strikes indicates continued offensive momentum. Polish airspace violation by Russian Mi-8 near Braniewo signals heightened Baltic-region probing. Data center strikes on Kyiv infrastructure suggest deliberate degradation of C4ISR and communications capacity.
sections.regional_response: Poland scrambled fighters and maintained ground alert following Mi-8 airspace violation; TVN24 and Polish military confirmed the incident. EU sanctions fatigue reported by Dombrovskis amid internal bloc disagreements, though Dombrovskis urged maintaining pressure on Moscow. US Rubio indicated no ceasefire agreement yet. Kuleba confirmed data center attacks and internet disruptions in Kyiv.
sections.intelligence_notes: The volume and diversity of munitions (ballistic missiles, Geran-5, Shahed, Banderol cruise, KABs) suggests Russia is exploiting stockpile depth for sustained multi-axis pressure. Syrsky's supply shortage claims, if accurate, indicate logistical strain on Ukrainian robotic systems. The ceasefire offer and rejection dynamic may be tactical ahead of winter operations. Zelenskyy's emphasis on Patriot missiles and winter package signals urgent capability gaps.
